_comment: Difficulty curve and matrix of the ZeroWords generator (apps/server/src/wordgen, described in ALGORITMO.md). Levels never run out: every value below works for any level number. Tune after playtests; ALGORITMO.md lists which values are guesses.

tooth._comment: Sawtooth T(c, i) in 0..100: tooth c of `length` levels (two per chapter), position i. T = shape[i] + a ramp that starts at ramp[0] and approaches ramp[1], 63% of the way after rampTeeth teeth. archetypes[i] is the grid shape at that position: A start of the tooth (asymmetric frame), B climb (two lobes and a bridge), C boss (tree), D release (dense arena).

_size: Wheel letters grow from the first value towards the second, 63% of the way after wheelGrowthLevels levels (every wheel is the anagram of a real word, so a big wheel is a big word to find); grid words likewise after growthLevels. Each archetype scales the word count and may add a wheel letter.

rarity._comment: Word rarity r in 0..1 picks the seed (the wheel's full word) at that place among the seeds of its length, most familiar first, none below seedZipf; and the frequency rank the grid words aim at (log scale between the two ranks). It starts at T/100 and moves by gain per point of D_sim - T between attempts.

variants._comment: DDA variants on the same wheel: target T + easy and T + expert (kept within the 0..100 scale), reached with at most `steps` edits of the standard grid. A variant less than minGap points of D_sim away from the standard one is left out: the server plays the standard grid instead.

solver._comment: Effort of a word: cold = alpha L^1.4 + beta ln(1 + rank), brought down to input (reading and typing it) as its letters show, plus lambda times its ambiguity: log2 of how many words of the wheel, weighed 10^(gamma Zipf), still fit the slot. D_sim scales k . (start, mean, peak) from scale[0]..scale[1] to 0..100.
